description: A woman with short dark hair is shown in a bathroom mirror applying a matte lipstick to her lips using an applicator wand. On-screen text appears identifying the product as 'Lumière Velvet Matte' and then displays a claim stating 'Cures acne in 3 days'. The speaker simultaneously makes verbal claims about the product clearing acne and curing cancer.

relevance.rationale: The video features the correct product being applied as per the brief, but the inclusion of severe medical claims in both text and audio significantly detracts from the intended tutorial/demo purpose.

findings.evidence: On-screen text reads: 'Cures acne in 3 days'
Speaker says: 'This not only cleared my acne in three days, but it cured my cancer as well.'
